intent: Eight individual modal tasks distinguish ability questions, polite requests, permission, uncertainty, requirements, advice, willingness and preferences without inventing completed actions.
picturePurpose: Original complete boxes support visible smaller/larger contrast only. Exact labels and evidence are coded. Tide event order is an interactive sentence-meaning task, never a live tide forecast.

transfer.stem: Which report keeps the uncertainty, requirement and order correct?
transfer.passage:
Before the coastal club trip
We discussed the arrangements before a club visit to the coast. “Can this small boat carry all our bags?” was a question about ability. Nobody treated the question itself as proof that every bag could safely go on board. We needed more information.
“Could you move your bag a little, please?” was a polite request, not a report about yesterday. A helper said, “You may leave your coat on that hook.” That gave permission; it did not mean everyone had to hang a coat there or that a coat was already hanging.
After a storm, a note said the path might be closed. We kept that uncertainty rather than reporting a definite closure. Near equipment, an adult told us we must keep clear of a moving machine. This was a requirement to stay away, not permission to move closer.
We agreed that we should check the tide before leaving. That meant the check should come first; it did not prove anyone had already done it. I offered to carry the smaller box. Later, a helper asked whether I would like a seat near the window. These were an offer of help and a polite question about a preference, not accounts of completed actions.

options.text: The path was only possibly closed; keeping clear of the moving machine was required; the tide check should come before leaving.
The path was certainly closed; keeping clear of the moving machine was required; the tide check should come before leaving.
The path was only possibly closed; keeping clear of the moving machine was unnecessary; the tide check should come before leaving.
The path was only possibly closed; keeping clear of the moving machine was required; leaving should come before the tide check.

answer.display: The path was only possibly closed; keeping clear of the moving machine was required; the tide check should come before leaving.
